_comment: The seeded library. Every ref points at a real id in the guide's things.json or restaurants.json, and scripts/check-refs.mjs proves it against the live feeds — including that each day keeps its own walking promise. Counts start at zero and are only ever raised by people actually doing a day; a Btown Brief pick says so instead of showing a number nobody earned.

days.name: The Parents Are Visiting
days.blurb: Slow pace, good views, and nobody walks more than ten minutes.
days.author: Btown Brief

stops.note: Sit-down breakfast a block off the water.
Benches the whole way and the lake in front of you.
Indoors if it turns, and you can sit down in there.
Book it a week out. Opens at four on Saturdays.

days.name: Broke But It's August
days.blurb: Free the whole way through, except for one creemee at the end.
days.author: Btown Brief

stops.note: Start here before the lot fills.
North along the water as far as your legs want.
Everybody's dog is here.
Stay for the sunset. It's the whole point.
The one thing you pay for all day.

days.name: Rainy Sunday, No Car
days.blurb: Eight blocks, all of it indoors, and none of it a mall.
days.author: Btown Brief

stops.note: Start warm and dry.
Free, and small enough to do properly.
An hour disappears in here.
Vermont makers, no pressure to buy.
Somebody is always playing something.

days.name: A First Date That Actually Works
days.blurb: Built for talking. Nothing here is so loud you have to lean in and shout.
days.author: Btown Brief

stops.note: Something to talk about in the first ten minutes.
One drink, outside if the patio's open.
Loud enough to be easy, quiet enough to hear.

days.name: New In Town
days.blurb: The day you give someone who just moved here and hasn't found anything yet.
days.author: Btown Brief

stops.note: This is where the town actually is on a Saturday.
Walk the whole block once, top to bottom.
Now you understand why people stay.
Sit outside and eavesdrop.
The room everyone ends up in eventually.

days.name: Four Hours Before A Flight
days.blurb: Tight, walkable, and it ends fifteen minutes from the airport road.
days.author: Btown Brief

stops.note: One pass, no dawdling.
The only souvenir worth carrying home.
Fast, good, and open at lunch.

days.name: South End Saturday
days.blurb: Art in old factory buildings, then the breweries that moved in next door.
days.author: Btown Brief

stops.note: Start at the top of Pine and work down.
Half of these didn't exist five years ago.
Sit at the bar, not a table.
Four minutes from the brewery and open late.

days.name: With Kids, Under Ten
days.blurb: Somewhere to run, somewhere to hide from the weather, and food before the meltdown.
days.author: Btown Brief

stops.note: Burn the first two hours here.
The indoor half of the day, whatever the sky says.
Crepes, and nobody minds the noise.

days.name: A Weird Burlington Day
days.blurb: For when you've lived here six years and keep doing the same three things. You'll want a car.
days.author: Btown Brief

stops.note: Nobody who lives here has been. Go anyway.
Winooski, ten minutes, worth the bridge.
Furniture you don't need and will think about all week.
Cheap seats, and the late show is the better one.

days.name: Cheap Date Night
days.blurb: Under forty dollars for two, and it doesn't feel like it.
days.author: Btown Brief

stops.note: Sunset first. It's free and it does the work.
Momos, and the bill won't frighten anybody.
Whatever's on is on. That's the deal.
